request.description: Single square carved-skull relief block for a quiet purple dungeon pillar, full FRONT view. A small simplified skull is carved from exactly the SAME muted violet-gray stone as its thick square beveled masonry slab, INTEGRATED BAS RELIEF with dark eye recesses. NO white bone, NO separate floating skull, NO crown. The relief fits inside a strong rectangular stone block with a quiet flat bevel and one deep recessed outline, 24 pixels wide within a 32 pixel canvas. Low contrast dark purple stone, top-left restrained highlight, broad flat plane shading, clean native pixel clusters, restrained chunky 16-bit mobile dungeon style. Full isolated object, transparent background, no scene, no border jewels or UI. Must belong to the existing side pillars in the reference.

reference_images.usage: The recessed skull-carved purple blocks in the SIDE pillars are the object/material target. Ignore the game board and UI.
